facts: NBS Circular 592 (pp. 59–60) states that Type 304 stainless steel is particularly effective in resisting nitric acid.
NBS Circular 592 (pp. 59–60) states that in 2 N mixed acids (ranging from 2 N HNO3 to 2 N H2SO4) Type 304’s behavior reflects its immunity to nitric acid and its susceptibility to sulfuric acid.
NBS Circular 592 (p. 60) reports that stainless steels were reported resistant to fuming nitric acid but that resistance decreased with increasing temperature up to about 160°F.
NBS Circular 592 (pp. 59–60) describes embrittlement and intergranular oxidation/corrosion of some stainless steels at high temperatures due to precipitation of chromium carbides at grain boundaries.
